entity.name: BreatheOSS
entity.description: A fully FOSS full-stack app and community initiative to improve AQI monitoring across Jammu and Kashmir. Maintained by sidharthify (Lead Dev) and FlashWreck (DevOps/Ops), with support from community contributors.

projects.name: Breathe Android App
projects.description: Android application for hyper-local AQI monitoring.

projects.name: Breathe Website
projects.description: TypeScript-based web interface for the initiative and AQI monitoring.

projects.name: Breathe iOS App
projects.description: iOS application for AQI monitoring (Work in Progress).

projects.name: Breathe Discord Bot
projects.description: Python-based Discord bot for community data access and engagement.

projects.name: Breathe Backend API
projects.description: Python backend API handling Open-Meteo and AirGradient sensor data processing. As well as being publicly available to access, either freely or through the apps/website/bot.

channels.description: UPI or Indian bank transfer available upon request. Contact via email for details.

plans.name: Domain Name Renewal
plans.description: Annual cost to keep the BreatheOSS domain running. Note: Infrastructure and hosting are currently secured via GitHub Education/Heroku.

plans.name: Hardware: AQI Sensor Unit
plans.description: Cost to procure one complete physical AQI sensor unit for deployment in J&K.

plans.name: Goodwill Support
plans.description: Pay anything you wish to show your goodwill for the project. Every little bit helps us keep the initiative running. Contact via email for payment details.
